Sword & Shield series · SHF

Shining Fates

Released February 19, 2021 · 73 cards

Expanded

Shining Fates is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on February 19, 2021. Its main set has 72 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (73 in total). It includes 58 Pokémon, 15 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
